events.comment: BOUNCE BACK - all tuning numbers are scene variables (1 Unity unit = 64 px). Esc goes back to the menu.
M1 Ball controller: speed up over time and keep rolling right. Camera follows sideways.
M6 Screen shake: counts frames (still runs while the game is frozen).
M2 Level generator: one floor segment per frame until the floor reaches SpawnAhead past the ball. First SafeSegments are hazard-free with no gaps.
M2 Cleanup: delete level pieces far behind the ball.
M3 Hotbar: 1/2/3 select, R flips the ramp, left click places the selected item at the mouse (if off cooldown).
Ramps placed near the floor snap down so their low end touches it (otherwise the ball wedges under them).
M3 Items vanish ItemLifetime seconds after being placed.
M3 Trampoline: launch the ball upward at BounceSpeed on every hit.
M6 Items blink during their last second.
M6 Ghost preview: a see-through copy of the selected item follows the mouse (dimmer while on cooldown).
M6 Second Chance bubble: grab it and the next death bounces you back to the last safe floor instead.
M3 Hotbar text.
M4 Score = furthest distance in metres (Unity units).
Death: spikes, hazard walls, or falling below DeathY.

parameters: "Distance: " + ToString(Score) + " m" + NewLine() + "Best: " + ToString(Best) + " m" + NewLine() + "Bounces: " + ToString(Bounces) + NewLine() + NewLine() + "Press Space to bounce back"

events.comment: Space restarts after dying. Esc returns to the menu any time.
Title screen: your image is the Background sprite (assets/start_background.png). Invisible button zones sit over the labels painted in the image.
Hover highlight on the painted buttons.
Start: Space, 1, or clicking PRESS SPACE / START GAME.
Controls (2) and Credits (3) panels; the same key, Esc, Space or a click closes them.
